metadata.subtitle: Experimental Long-Range Temperature Forecasting | April 2026 – March 2030
metadata.forecast_horizon: Four years (48 months, 1,461 daily predictions including 2028-02-29 leap day)
metadata.disclaimer: EXPERIMENTAL LONG-RANGE FORECAST — NOT AN OPERATIONAL WEATHER FORECAST.

Holt-Winters Damped.methodology: Trained on all 11,035 historical observations up to 18 March 2026 with additive 365-day seasonality and damped trend (phi = 0.9891). Over 1,474 future steps, the damped trend term gradually asymptotes toward a finite constant rather than extrapolating an unbounded linear slope.

XGBoost Recursive.exogenous_strategy: Historical Day-of-Year Climatological Expectation (1996–2026) for unavailable future DTR, humidity, and rain
XGBoost Recursive.methodology: Retrained on all 10,670 post-warmup historical observations up to 18 March 2026 using all 25 causal features. At each future step from 19 March 2026 to 31 March 2030, predicted tmean is fed into next-day lags (1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 365) and shifted rolling means/stds (7, 14, 30d), illustrating how step-by-step recursive predictions evolve and accumulate variance.

XGBoost Direct Seasonal.methodology: Retrained on all 10,670 historical observations up to 18 March 2026 using 8 calendar, Fourier harmonic, training-derived DOY climatology, and annual lag_365 features. Avoids short-term recursive lag drift, but cannot anticipate future synoptic anomalies or multi-year climate regime shifts.
